title: Check the principal domain
text: First, identify if the angle $$\frac{4\pi}{7}$$ falls within the principal range of the inverse cosine function.

title: Compare the domain and range
text: Observe that $$0<\frac{4\pi}{7}<\pi,$$ so it is already inside the valid principal range of the inverse cosine.

title: Definition of inverse
text: Thus for the given angle, the inverse identity holds and we have $$\arccos(\cos(\theta))=\theta.$$
